name: TAF Demographic and Eligibility (DE) Base File
description: The TAF Demographic and Eligibility (DE) Base File contains annual, beneficiary-level demographic and enrollment summary information for individuals enrolled in Medicaid or CHIP at any point during the year. One record per beneficiary per state per year. Note: not all states are available in TAF data from 2014-2015, as this was a transition period between MAX and TAF. From 2016-2018, all states are available.
